parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello?

Hello Rob, Margaret here. I'm just calling about the arrangements for Dad's 80th birthday party.

Right, I have rung round the rest of the family. Most people do intend to come, even though it's a long journey. Have you made any progress with the venue?

Yes, there are three possible hotels we could use for the party. The Royal, the Star and the Winchester.

Oh good. If we can make a decision now, you can probably book straight away on the internet, can't you?

Well, only the Star. I'd have to make a telephone booking at the others, but that'd be okay too.

Okay. So which one do you think?

I'm not sure. They're all fairly suitable, and they're in really nice locations. The Star looks right out over the bay. It's on a cliff top. Then the Winchester is in lovely countryside too.

Yes, it's in the valley, isn't it?

Yes. What about Mum's wheelchair? How easy would it be for her to get in and out of these places?

Well, I know that the Winchester would be fine, and the Star, because I've been there with her before. I wasn't sure about the Royal, because I seemed to remember it had a lot of steps, so I checked. And apparently it's had ramps installed recently, so there wouldn't be any problem there either.

Oh. And what about the kids? Which one do you think would be most suitable for them? Have they got play areas or anything?

The Royal hasn't got anything, but the Winchester has one. It's on the ground floor, they said, not far from the dining room.

The Star's got one too, but it isn't under cover, and we don't know what the weather will be like, do we?

Um, true!

Then there's the birthday meal itself. The Royal's the only one where there'd be a choice. The other two have a set menu at lunchtime. Mind you, they all do very good food apparently, so the quality should be fine.

I don't think it really matters whether there's a variety or not, but I think we need to have our own room, don't you?

The only one that can provide that is the Royal. The Winchester and the Star only have one dining room, so we'd just be sitting with the other guests, but in a separate area of the room.

That's not quite the same, is it?

No, but the other thing to consider is the price. Normally there's not much difference between them. Perhaps the Star's slightly cheaper than the other two, but the Winchester is offering quite a good reduction because there's so many of us. The Star and the Royal would just charge their standard rates.

So, taking everything into consideration, which one do you think we should go for?

The Winchester, unless you...

Okay, that's fine by me. You've obviously gone into everything very carefully.

You've done nearly all the work so far, so what can I do now to help?

Well, could you manage the finances?

Of course. Do they want the whole amount in advance?

Just a deposit. I'll find out how much and let you know. Then if you could, send that straight away to secure the booking.

Fine.

And I'll go and buy some invitations.

Oh, don't do that. I can produce them. I've got a program on my computer. It's easy.

Okay, thanks.

Then, once we've had the replies, I'll call everyone who's coming to find out if they want transport.

Great. I can help out with that. Pick people up from the station or whatever.

Okay.

Oh, yes. And could you stress that Dad doesn't want presents? He keeps reminding me. He says there's nothing he really needs.

Okay. I'll try to discourage them, but you know what people are like. Anything else? Shall I do...?

analyses.content: 录音中提到 Star 酒店面朝海湾（looks right out over the bay），对应题目中的海景（sea view）。
The Star looks right out over the bay. It's on a cliff top. Then the Winchester is in lovely countryside too.
你听到 "locations" 可能会走神，注意区分三个酒店的具体朝向，不要把 "valley"（山谷，Winchester）当成海景。
I wasn't sure about the Royal, because I seemed to remember it had a lot of steps, so I checked. And apparently it's had ramps installed recently, so there wouldn't be any problem there either.
不要听到 Royal 有 "a lot of steps"（很多台阶）就排除它，重点是后面转折说的 "recently... no problem there either"。
Winchester 和 Star 之前去过都没问题，而 Royal 最近安装了坡道（ramps installed），所以三家酒店都适合轮椅出入。
The Royal hasn't got anything, but the Winchester has one. ... The Star's got one too, but it isn't under cover, and we don't know what the weather will be like, do we?
不要听到 Star 也有 "one" 就选，录音强调用 "but it isn't under cover" 来否定 Star 的游乐区适合全天候（即非室内）。
Winchester 的游乐区在底楼（ground floor），而 Star 的不在室内（not under cover），所以有室内游乐区的是 Winchester。
The Royal's the only one where there'd be a choice. The other two have a set menu at lunchtime.
不要听到 "all do very good food" 就选 D（所有），题目问的是 "choice"（选择权），不是食品质量。
录音明确说 Royal 是唯一一个提供选择（choice）的地方，而其他两家是固定套餐（set menu）。
I think we need to have our own room, don't you? The only one that can provide that is the Royal.
注意听 "The only one that can provide that"，直接锁定单一选项，排除 "separate area" 这种干扰项。
Royal 是唯一能提供独立房间（our own room）的酒店，其他两家只是在公共餐厅划分区域。
Winchester 提供很好的减价（reduction），因为人数多，这对应题目中的团体折扣（group discount）。
Perhaps the Star's slightly cheaper than the other two, but the Winchester is offering quite a good reduction because there's so many of us.
不要因为 Star "slightly cheaper"（稍微便宜点）就选它，题目问的是 "discount"（折扣动作），而不是原本定价低。

analyses.content: Do they want the whole amount in advance? Just a deposit. I'll find out how much and let you know. Then if you could, send that straight away to secure the booking.
不要填 "amount" 或 "finances"，题目是 "Send a..."，需要填具体的支付形式。
女士确认只需要预付 deposit（定金），并要求尽快寄出去以锁定预订。
女士提议去买，但男士说他可以用电脑程序 produce（制作）invitations（请以此对应题干中的 Make）。
原文是 "produce them"，题目是 "Make the..."，这是典型的同义替换，指代上文提到的 invitations。
And I'll go and buy some invitations. Oh, don't do that. I can produce them. I've got a program on my computer.
Then, once we've had the replies, I'll call everyone who's coming to find out if they want transport.
不要填 "station"，那是具体接人的地点，题目问的是 "help with..."（在某方面提供帮助），对应原文 "want transport"。
收到回复后，需要给每个人打电话确认他们是否需要 transport（交通/接送）。
Oh, yes. And could you stress that Dad doesn't want presents? He keeps reminding me.
注意题目是否定的 "not to bring"，对应录音中的 "doesn't want"，不要漏听否定词。
男士被要求强调爸爸不想要 presents（礼物），因为他什么都不缺。
